name: Dr. Darley and the Case of the Deboned Children
source:
World-renowned physician Dr. Antony Darley is called to a small mining town to investigate a bizarre medical case involving children losing their bones while they sleep. Over the course of his investigation, the Doctor begins to suspect the problem may not be medical, but criminal in nature...

[From [url=https://pliantpress.itch.io/darley01] itch.io[/url]]
